_authoring.purpose: Explain the text library to human authors and coding AI.
_authoring.experience: Playful erotic fantasy about Milk Maids, milk-related situations and teasing equipment.
_authoring.format: Structured shorthand: short labeled facts; one idea per field.
_authoring.label_goal: Describe what the player wants to customize and what editing it changes.
_authoring.perspective: Affected character, speaker and listener are separate roles.
_authoring.boundary: Internal authoring notes only. Do not display or append them to game prompts.
_authoring.verification: Read the actual caller before claiming a trigger, speaker or gameplay effect.

Lore & Background.purpose: Customize world knowledge and narration style.
Lore & Background.distinguish: General lore, confirmed actor identity and global instructions are separate entries.

Your Character’s Speaking Style.perspective: First-person player speech, not nearby NPC conversation.

Becoming a Milk Maid.purpose: Customize conversion and curse reactions or stories.
Becoming a Milk Maid.distinguish: New Milk Maid, existing Milk Maid and added milk are different outcomes.

Drinking Milk & Breastfeeding.purpose: Customize reactions to drinking and breastfeeding.
Drinking Milk & Breastfeeding.distinguish: Drinker, milk source and observer are different characters; drink effects come from gameplay.

Milking & Fullness.purpose: Customize reactions to stored milk and milking.
Milking & Fullness.distinguish: Becoming full, being milked and finishing milking are different events.

Armor Reactions.purpose: Customize reactions and stories about putting on or losing armor.
Armor Reactions.distinguish: Story popups, AI reactions and armor-status fragments are different text types.

Living / Parasite Teasing.purpose: Customize messages and reactions to living armor effects.
Living / Parasite Teasing.distinguish: HUD wording and AI effect descriptions use separate pools; tiers organize alternatives.

Dwemer Armor.purpose: Customize device lore, wearer reactions and messages.
Dwemer Armor.distinguish: Full suits, installed attachments and individual device events have different context.

Thoughts & Cravings.purpose: Customize selected thoughts, cravings and their AI expression.
Thoughts & Cravings.distinguish: The thought/message is separate from instructions for reacting to it.

Arousal & Movement.purpose: Customize messages accompanying arousal, movement and body effects.
Arousal & Movement.boundary: Text describes selected effects; it does not enable or apply them.

Service Reminders.purpose: Customize messages about equipment and available services.
Service Reminders.boundary: Wording does not change service availability, prices or requirements.

Armor Locks.purpose: Customize messages about armor locks and removal attempts.
Armor Locks.boundary: Text does not change a lock or unlock requirement.
